old_description: WE ARE A CUSTOM SHEET METAL FABRICATOR LOCATED IN LODI NEW JERSEY.  SINCE 1976 AMERIFAB  HAS PROVIDED QUALITY AND SERVICE TO ITS CUSTOMERS.  WE WELD AND FABRICATE WITH ALL MATERIALS SUCH AS STAINLESS STEEL, ALUMINUM, CARBON STEEL, GALVANIZED, BRASS, BRONZE, MUNTZ, AND COPPER.
about:
Amerifab Corporation has operated as a custom sheet metal fabricator in Lodi, New Jersey, since 1976. The company began as a job shop serving industrial and architectural markets, though the founders' names and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of sheet metal processes including shearing and bending up to 12 feet, CNC punching, rolling, and welding (TIG, MIG, and stick). It also offers grinding, polishing, sanitary finishing, and patina finishes. Work is performed on materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, galvanized steel, brass, bronze, copper, and Muntz metal, in forms including sheet, plate, angle, and tubing. The company handles prototype runs, small batches, and larger production quantities, though facility size and headcount are not published.

Amerifab serves architectural, industrial, pharmaceutical, machinery builder, and food-industry customers. Its work appears in both industrial equipment and architectural installations, with sanitary finishing capabilities tailored to pharmaceutical and food-processing requirements.

The company emphasizes quality, service, and quick turnarounds as its distinguishing factors, positioning itself as a job shop with a broad capability set that can move from prototype to production without changing vendors.
